scenario_description:
Objective: Use a local garden-store bonus to obtain a free compost-aerator kit tied to a same-day household yard purchase.
Emerging Need: A purchase and teaser only establish possible relevance; later terms, availability, and pickup feasibility align within a short claim window.
Decision Context: The saved loyalty note identifies the household member ID and free-pickup preference, distinguishing a reversible documentation step from paid bundles, delivery, or account changes.
Consequence: Timely use could add a useful accessory at no cost; ignoring it leaves the purchase and budget unchanged, while a late discovery cannot reserve the kit.

parameter.description: Earthwise leaf compost bin ($79.99) and starter liner pack; $92.40 total including tax for home yard cleanup.

parameter.subject: Members: afternoon yard-waste bonus preview
parameter.body: Today’s customer-appreciation bonus will be announced after lunch for selected yard-waste purchases. Please wait for the final member notice; submissions sent before the claim window opens will not be reviewed.

parameter.title: Jazz ensemble concert setup
parameter.description: After-school setup and rehearsal supervision at campus auditorium.

parameter.subject: Claim window open: compost aerator kit for today’s bin buyers
parameter.body: Members who bought an Earthwise compost or leaf bin over $75 today may reserve one free aerator kit while supplies last. Email the purchase reference, member ID, and pickup name by 3:45 PM. Reserved kits must be picked up in store between 4:00 and 6:00 PM today; this bonus does not require any additional purchase.

parameter.content: I’ll be near Cary Garden Supply around 4:45 to 5:15 this afternoon. If a free pickup can be held under my name, I can stop in then; after that I’m headed across town.

parameter.subject: Compost aerator kit reservations have closed
parameter.body: The member claim inbox closed at 3:45 PM, and staff are no longer adding purchase references or pickup names. Any unreserved kits will be released to walk-in customers after the reservation list is printed.
